== Description ==

At a long table at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025: [[Brandon Baity]] (front left, olive zip jacket and khaki pants), [[Spencer Gosiaco]] (back right, black Mariners cap and black jacket), and [[Nathan Davis]] (front right, blue cap and navy Mariners shirt); back-left opponent unlabeled.
